name: claude-codex-windows-notify
description: Native Windows notifications for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode, with exact-pane return for WezTerm.

interface.shortDescription: Windows notifications for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode; enhanced for WezTerm
interface.longDescription: Shows completion and approval notifications with sound, the session name, and response previews for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode. Clicking a notification returns you to the session: the exact pane in WezTerm, or the window of the app hosting the terminal elsewhere, including an integrated terminal in VS Code or Cursor.
defaultPrompt: Explain how my Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode Windows notifications work
